snippet.title: Chlorine Scales, a moody retro point-and-click adventure.
snippet.description:
Explore a strange black-and-white city in this hand-drawn point-and-click adventure. Investigate bizarre characters, kick their asses, and perform a mysterious money ritual before your rent is due in 7 days.

#indiegame #pointandclick #gametrailers
